content:
Parametrize the circle:
\[
x=2+\cos\theta,\quad y=\sin\theta.
\]
Then
\[
3x+4y-3=3(2+\cos\theta)+4\sin\theta-3=3+3\cos\theta+4\sin\theta.
\]
Since
\[
3\cos\theta+4\sin\theta=5\cos(\theta-\phi)
\]
for some \(\phi\), we get
\[
3x+4y-3=3+5\cos(\theta-\phi).
\]
Thus the expression ranges from \(3-5=-2\) to \(3+5=8\), so the maximum absolute value is
\[
\boxed{8}.
\]
